map.两个相近频率叠加产生拍，拍频为二者之差。: Two close frequencies superpose into beats; the beat frequency is their difference.
map.440 与 444 Hz 叠加产生 4 Hz 拍。: 440 and 444 Hz superpose into a 4 Hz beat.
map.📚 深度解析：计算两音的拍频: 📚 Deep Dive: Computing the beat frequency of two tones
map.吉他或提琴调音时，听两弦差值产生的拍来对齐频率。: When tuning guitar or violin, listen to the beat between two strings to align their frequencies.
map.示波器/音频中判断两个相近频率的干涉。: Judge interference of two close frequencies on a scope or in audio.
map.校准音叉或发生器时观察拍消失点。: Observe the beat-disappearance point when calibrating tuning forks or generators.
map.两把音叉频率 f1=440 Hz、f2=444 Hz，拍频 f_beat=|f1: Two tuning forks at f1=440 Hz and f2=444 Hz give f_beat=|f1-f2|=4 Hz, i.e. 4 loudness swells per second; as the frequencies converge the beat frequency approaches 0.
map.两个频率相近的声波叠加，合成振幅按差值频率周期性起伏，人耳听到响度的周期性涨落就: Two close-frequency waves superpose so the resultant amplitude fluctuates at the difference frequency; the ear hears periodic loudness swells, which are the beats.
map.拍频能超过两频率吗？: Can the beat frequency exceed the two frequencies?
map.不能，拍频等于两频率之差的绝对值，必然小于其中较高的频率。: No; the beat frequency equals the absolute difference of the two frequencies, necessarily below the higher of them.
map.拍频 f_beat = |f₁ − f₂|（两频率差的绝对值）；另输出平均频率: Beat frequency f_beat = |f₁ − f₂| (the absolute difference between the two frequencies); it also outputs the mean frequency = (f₁+f₂) ÷ 2, the beat period = 1 ÷ f_beat, and the relative deviation % = f_beat ÷ ((f₁+f₂)÷2 or 1) × 100 (falling back to 1 when the mean is 0 to avoid division by zero). Validation: f₁ and f₂ are both required valid values (the required-field shell blocks invalid input). Criteria: the closer the two frequencies, the smaller the beat frequency and the longer the beat period; the relative deviation reflects how detuned the two sources are.
